body:
## Context

A host app (oh-my-byted) shows identifiers — pod names like `dp-09aa6aec4c-55d96c7899-kbzgl`, IPs, versions, ticket/cluster IDs — in `Table`s and detail rows. Users need to tell `0` from `O` (ideally also `I` / `l` / `1`), and numeric columns should align.

## What's missing today (0.1.7)

1. **No monospace in typography.** `ThemeTypography` has a single `family` (+ `fallbacks`) for every role, and `TypographyToken` is only `size` / `line_height` / `weight`. A theme can't declare a code/mono face, so scripts hard-code `style().font_family("Menlo")`, which ignores the active theme.
2. **No per-column font in `Table`.** Column props are `key/title/width/align/sortable/resizable/min_width/max_width/adornments`; cells render `text(cell.text)` with a fixed style. The only hook is `part_styles.row` / `row_selected`, which styles the whole row.
3. **`span()` can't change font.** Rich-text spans take color / bold / italic only (no family, no background), so "inline code" inside a sentence isn't possible.

## Workaround we ship

System font + OpenType features instead of a mono face: `style().font_feature("cv08", 1).font_feature("tnum", 1)`. SF's GSUB has no `zero` feature, but `cv08` / `ss06` map `zero` (and `zero.tnum`) to a slashed glyph (checked with fontTools on `SFNS.ttf`, rendered with CoreText). Applied to tables via `part_styles: #{ row: s, row_selected: s }`; the text inherits through `apply_typography`'s `text_style` refinement. This fixes `0`/`O` and digit alignment, but not `I`/`l`, and it relies on SF-specific feature tags.

## Proposal (any subset helps)

a. Optional `family` / `fallbacks` on `TypographyToken`, so a theme can add a role such as
   `code: { size: 12px, line_height: 16px, weight: 400, family: "SF Mono", fallbacks: ["Menlo"] }`
   and scripts use `typography("code")`. (Alternative: theme-level `mono_family` + `style().font_mono()`.)
b. A per-column text style for `Table` (array and native-collection rows), e.g. `typography: "code"` or `cell_style: style()` on the column, including `font_features`.
c. Nice to have: `span()` accepting a family / background for inline code.

## Acceptance

- Switching theme changes the mono face used by `typography("code")` (or the equivalent).
- A table with one mono column renders only that column's cells in the mono face, for both array rows and a `NativeCollection`; the other columns keep the body face.
title: Typography: theme-configurable monospace face, and per-column font for Table
